clue.text: Might he get one person lbw?

definitions.text: Might he get one person lbw?

blocks.clueFragment: Might he get one person lbw?

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether some man could manage to get one particular person lbw.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, lbw (leg before wicket) is a way of dismissing a batsman whose leg blocks a ball that would hit the stumps; slow bowlers who turn the ball claim many such wickets.
